I do not buy chemical fertilizer for this small plot because my perennial plants and fruit trees grow well enough with the manure and compost I collect from our animals. It is only 0.06 hectares, so my family and I can easily tend to it ourselves without paying for outside help. Weeding, pruning, and harvesting will keep us busy for a few weeks, but the land is ours and the work is manageable.
